Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J25/J25nB171.xml). Recorded Sayings of Monk Tianyin. Tianyin Yuanxiu owns the retained deployment: direct instruction before the sitting place.

Senses.Explanation: The words literally describe raising or straightening the spine. The retained passages deploy that bodily action while seated and extend it to resolute application; the phrase alone does not name a contemplative method. Guting Shanjian directly describes raising the spine on a cushion and continuing without lying down. Tianyin Yuanxiu directly instructs raising the spine while seated before the sitting place.
